# goose 1.46.0 codex provider - captured codex CLI argv
# Source: CODEX_COMMAND pointed at a wrapper that logged argv + a whitelist of
# env vars, then exec'd the real codex 0.153.4 binary. Temp paths redacted to <TMP>.
# Command that produced each block:
#   env HOME=<TMP>/home[N] CODEX_HOME=<TMP>/codexhome CODEX_COMMAND=<TMP>/bin/codex-wrap.sh \
#       [CODEX_REASONING_EFFORT=<val>] CODEX_SKIP_GIT_CHECK=true GOOSE_MODE=<mode> \
#       GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING=true GOOSE_DISABLE_SESSION_NAMING=true \
#       goose run --no-session -q --recipe <TMP>/recipe.yaml < /dev/null
# The recipe sets settings.goose_provider=codex, settings.goose_model=gpt-5.4-mini.
# goose invokes:  <CODEX_COMMAND> exec -c model_reasoning_effort="<effort>" --json [--yolo] -
# The prompt is piped to codex on stdin (positional "-"). goose does NOT forward -m/--model;
# codex uses its own config/default model (this probe pinned model="gpt-5.4-mini" in
# <TMP>/codexhome/config.toml so the live call used gpt-5.4-mini).


===== RUN A: GOOSE_MODE=auto, CODEX_REASONING_EFFORT=high (recipe-driven) =====
=== INVOCATION 1788809108 ===
arg0=<TMP>/bin/codex-wrap.sh
arg[0]=exec
arg[1]=-c
arg[2]=model_reasoning_effort="high"
arg[3]=--json
arg[4]=--yolo
arg[5]=-
env CODEX_HOME=<TMP>/codexhome
env CODEX_COMMAND=<TMP>/bin/codex-wrap.sh
env CODEX_REASONING_EFFORT=high
env CODEX_SKIP_GIT_CHECK=true
env GOOSE_MODE=auto
env GOOSE_PROVIDER=<unset>
env GOOSE_MODEL=<unset>
--- end invocation ---

===== RUN B: GOOSE_MODE=approve, CODEX_REASONING_EFFORT unset  (note: --yolo absent; effort defaults to high) =====
